## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle Southern-Sòng polemical *zhēn* 箴 (admonition) by **Shàngwēng Miàolián** 上翁妙蓮 ([妙蓮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A6%99%E8%93%AE)) — companion piece to the larger [KR6k0221](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0221) *Péngzhé zhíbiàn*. Both works target *Tiěwēng Shǒuyī*'s 鐵翁守一 *Zhōngnán jiāyè* ([KR6k0219](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0219)). Where the *Zhíbiàn* mounts a structured doctrinal refutation, the *Zhēn* is an aphoristic-rhetorical *zhēn* (admonition), framed by personal recollection.

**Abstract**

The *Péngzhé zhēn* is a condensed companion to [KR6k0221](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0221): it presents the same *Zhōngnán jiāyè* citations and rebuttals (the *miàoguān* foundation question, the *vinaya*-as-Mahāyāna *yuánshí* 圓實 thesis) but in an aphoristic-admonitory rather than treatise mode. The personal episode at the opening — Tiěwēng visiting Miàolián at *Húxīnsì* (one of West Lake's island-temples) during the *Shàodìng* reign — is biographically valuable. Composition is bracketed by 1241 (the *Chúnyòu* opening of [KR6k0221](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0221)) and 1254 (the *Bǎoyòu* 2 colophon); `notBefore`–`notAfter` set accordingly. Together the two *Péngzhé* pieces are the only sustained Southern-Sòng *Língzhī*-school polemical response to *Rìshān* Vinaya teaching.
